description: This file defines a React functional component 'AdditionalModelSettings' that provides a user interface for configuring AI model parameters such as temperature and max tokens, including use of advanced parameters. It manages local and external state, incorporates UI elements like sliders, checkboxes, tooltips, and handles user interactions.

methods.name: AdditionalModelSettings
methods.description: React functional component for adjusting AI model settings like temperature and max tokens with optional external control.

methods.name: handleTemperatureChange
methods.description: Handles change in temperature input, updates local state and calls external callback if provided.

methods.name: handleMaxTokensChange
methods.description: Handles change in max tokens input, updates local state and calls external callback if provided.

methods.name: handleUseAdvancedParamsChange
methods.description: Handles toggle of advanced parameters checkbox, updates internal state or calls external callback.
